gaps: Decision 0064 requires the existing three review artifacts and forbids another registry, contradicting the one-generation plus selected-pointer design.
The draft incorrectly attributes CI-transport-only preliminary PR behavior to Decision 0054, which permits a draft for review and green CI.
A pointer created by a later upgrade cannot exist in an already sealed historical marker commit.
Citation-based finding rejection has no immutable generation origin and would falsely claim a changed projection came from unchanged helper output.
Combined-review section parsing and cross-lens duplicate normalization are not deterministic.
Ordinary-chat questions have no durable open state, so the claimed handoff precondition cannot observe them.
The handoff design has no exclusive coordinator ownership or fencing and could allow split-brain coordination.
The nine-part question identity has no exact issuance sources, missing-field rules, or final resolution schema.
Mandatory adapter-event task proof conflicts with the existing best-effort event family and schema.
The event matrix does not name the exact structured-question and mutation tools covered per runtime.
The governing-decision list omits active decisions and acceptance does not preserve Decision 0059 dependency fallback or Decision 0060 signal behavior.
The Product Brief still describes review-before-commit, one autoreview pass, and only one planning-lock escape.
Genuine-contribution acceptance invents a product-tree snapshot despite the one branch-diff digest boundary.
Required metrics and trace integration have no acceptance proof.
Workspace-first planning conflicts with the existing pre-worktree grill test and the legacy stage-start trunk route, while safe attach is undefined.
Setup selection does not name public commands or say whether a coordinator choice persists.
Immutable event retention does not define what happens when a late eligible event appears.
The protected plan and decomposition still assign D-0032 and fixed-review migration inconsistently with the amended specification.
resolutions: Accepted Decision 0067 now amends only Decision 0064's physical publication shape to one task-local immutable generation and one selected pointer, while retaining genuine three-lens proof and the ban on independent authority.
Accepted Decision 0067 now narrows Decision 0054 only for this story: an early draft exists solely when required platform CI cannot run otherwise and grants no review or proof authority.
The migration contract now makes the upgrade generation bind the immutable historical marker and exact fixed bytes; sealed readers accept the later pointer only on an exact sealed-commit match.

The review schema now includes origin=rejection. Rejection creates an immutable successor with source hash, exact finding, reason, citation, and actor while preserving raw output and unaffected lenses.
Architecture now fixes exact full-line lens markers, chunk labels, one lowercase tag, and one NFC repo-path/line/normalized-title fingerprint for cross-lens duplicate refusal.
The spec removes machine claims about open ordinary chat: the current turn blocks, abandonment grants no authority, and a later coordinator asks again.
The live handoff protocol is removed. Decision 0053's simpler between-task switch remains: old session stops, the completed marker and CI are on trunk, and the new session resumes through forge next.

Structured identity is reduced to runtime, session, fresh event filename ID, and zero-based question index, with exact scope/input/content/answer fields; approval-bound changes use the existing decision or approval record rather than a new revision map.
Timeline events remain best-effort diagnostics under Decision 0017. Committed configuration, focused hook tests, and recorder-produced automated reports are the required proof.

Architecture now lists the literal Claude and Codex hook/tool matchers; asynchronous question issuance is guarded but is not completion evidence, and newly exposed tools require mapping before parity is claimed.

The spec binds every accepted decision returned by forge decision list --active and explicitly preserves empty-dependency predecessor fallback plus Decision 0060 signal-mask and truthful failure rules.
The Brief now states implementation/tests/verification before the review-fix loop, one lifecycle with three assessments, and the approved-plan, quickfix, Lite, and degraded boundaries.
Contribution proof now cites one qualifying hunk inside the existing binary branch diff and correlates it with admitted write and terminal evidence; no second digest exists.
Lifecycle acceptance now requires one sanitized correlated error, one bounded forge_native_unexpected_errors_total increment, trace joining by error ID, redaction, and nonzero propagation tests.

The contract makes task start create or safely attach the worktree before JIT planning, defines exact clean attach predicates and dependency semantics, removes the redundant old test, and excludes the legacy trunk route from parity acceptance.
Setup and forge doctor select a coordinator only for one invocation using argument, environment, detection, then TTY; init/adopt/upgrade install both adapters and persist no coordinator choice.
The first bundle stays immutable; any later eligible event makes preview/apply refuse and remain loose. Retry deletes only already represented identical events and V1 has no successor shards.

The replacement plan, external decomposition, and ownership graph assign complete D-0032 to NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE and one-time fixed-review migration to PORTABLE-DELIVERY-MIGRATION before protected replacement.

rounds.question: Spec amendment for FORGE-COORD-1: should the already-approved 2026-09-11 change move the complete one-call combined review into NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE now, while the 17 repository-answerable cold-read findings are corrected in the resolved draft?

summary: Resolved all 18 findings from the single user-requested simplified-spec reread. Decision 0067 carries the only new human choice; repository facts and accepted decisions resolve the rest. No second spec reread is run.
current_flow: Record this pass against the amended draft, confirm the spec, synchronize graph hashes, then run the one requested final plan grill.
